verdicts.reason: A keeps the can inside its circle and puts headline, brand and buttons in a sensible left-to-right group. But the left ~160px is empty, the body copy is stuck at the far right after the product, the CTA is no bigger than the badges, and the badge reads 'BACK BYDEMAND' with no space. B breaks the product art: the green circle is pulled away from the can and sits behind the body copy at the far left, so text overlaps it. Reading order starts with that body copy, and the 'SUMMER ONLY' badge text is tiny.
